title: THE CRYPT CULINARY ARTS // NED STARK'S MARROW
narrative: Lady Barbrey Dustin leans over the crypt sarcophagi of Winterfell with a silver ladle and a pouch of Northern peppercorns. 'People think I hate Eddard Stark because he didn't marry me,' she whispers to the shadows. 'Nonsense! I just wanted his femur for my world-famous winter bone broth! A Warden of the North's marrow has five times the collagen of a common goat! Once I get his skeleton back from the Neck, Barrowton will have the best pho in Westeros!'
resolvesPlotHole: Lady Dustin's Bizarre Obsession with Ned's Bones

options.text: Search the deeper crypts for Vermax's hidden dragon eggs.
Deliver the stock to Wyman Manderly for his Frey pastry gravy.
Offer a bowl to the murderous Ghost of Winterfell.
